edits.before: In this case, there is no variability in image specific quality. Fig. S1 shows the inference flowchart for this model. The embeddings from both branches, along with the constant auxiliary vector, are passed into the gated sum. The weighted sum is normalised. In the enrolment image, the model is identical. During inference, the training-only identity classifier has been removed.
edits.after: The auxiliary vector contains no image-specific quality variation. The gate takes both branch embeddings and the constant auxiliary vector as inputs. Its output weights the embeddings before their sum is normalised. The same model processes the enrolment image. During inference, the training-only identity classifier has been removed.
edits.reason: Repair extraction spacing and describe constant auxiliary inputs, not constant image quality.
